summary: This is a Git configuration file snippet that tells Git to use a specific credential manager program to handle storing and retrieving login credentials. Instead of prompting for a password each time, Git will delegate credential management to the Git Credential Manager executable located on the Windows filesystem.

explanations.1: The [credential] section header tells Git that the settings that follow apply to how it manages usernames and passwords.
explanations.2: The 'helper' setting points Git to an external program that will handle credential storage and retrieval; the double backslashes are escape characters needed because backslashes are special in configuration files.
